notes.title: Social media
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40010664/537ce683092a0e3738f0b4364cef109335c808aa.png

Hello, Guys!

As you well know, the game is constantly evolving, as we regularly show on our Steam page. But did you know that we're also present on other social-media channels?

We'd like to invite you to follow us also on other accounts, the links to which can be found below:
- Facebook,
- Twitter,
- Instagram.

See you there!
